segments.content: WLOG sort a₁ < a₂ < ... < aₙ (by applying a permutation)——将一般情形归一化为有序情形
Let x = a₁ + ... + a_{n-1} (sum of all but the largest element)——定义组织整个论证的关键量 x
We proceed by strong induction on n——建立强归纳框架
Three cases based on the position of M's elements relative to x——按 M 中元素相对 x 的位置划分三种情况
Case 1 条件: x ∈ M 且 ∃ y ∈ M with y > x，由此 n ≥ 3——给出情况1的触发条件
Among the n-1 small elements, define 'bad' index i if x - aᵢ ∈ M or s - aᵢ ∈ M——定义'坏指标'概念以启用计数
The map from bad indices to M\{x} is injective (x - aᵢ maps to M\{x} since x ∈ M and aᵢ > 0; s - aᵢ > x so maps to M∩(x,∞))——证明坏指标到 M\{x} 的映射是单射
Since |M\{x}| = n-2, there are at most n-2 bad indices among n-1 total——由单射+计数得坏指标数上界
so at least one good index r exists with x - aᵣ ∉ M and s - aᵣ ∉ M——从计数上界提取好指标的存在性
Let t = x - aᵣ, M' = M ∩ (-∞, t]. Then |M'| ≤ n-3 (since both x and y are excluded from M')——构造归纳用的子集 M' 并验证其规模
Apply induction to the n-2 remaining elements (excluding aᵣ and aₙ) with M', getting permutation p'——对子问题应用归纳假设
Construct the full permutation: place p' first, then aᵣ, then aₙ (with a swap to put aₙ second-to-last)——由归纳结果构造完整排列
All prefix sums before aᵣ are ≤ t and avoid M'; the sum up to aᵣ is s - aₙ = s - aᵣ - (sum of rest) which avoids M by choice of r; the final sum is s ∉ M——验证所有前缀和避开 M
Case 2 条件: x ∉ M 且 ∃ y ∈ M with y > x——给出情况2的触发条件
Then |M ∩ (-∞, x]| ≤ n-2. Let M' = M ∩ (-∞, x]——构造归纳用的子集 M' 并验证其规模
Apply induction to a₁,...,a_{n-1} with M' (sum = x ∉ M')——对子问题应用归纳假设
If M' is empty, use identity——处理 M' 为空的边界情形
Otherwise get permutation p', extend by placing aₙ last——由归纳结果构造完整排列
All prefix sums of first n-1 jumps are ≤ x and avoid M'; the final sum is s ∉ M——验证所有前缀和避开 M
Case 3 条件: all m ∈ M satisfy m ≤ x——给出情况3的触发条件
Let z = max(M), M' = M\{z}——构造归纳用的子集 M'
Apply induction to a₁,...,a_{n-1} with M' (|M'| = n-2). Get permutation p'——对子问题应用归纳假设
If some prefix sum of p' equals z at position k, swap position k with the last position: place aₙ at position k (jumping over z since aₙ > a_{p'(k)}), and place a_{p'(k)} last——通过交换修复命中 z 的位置
If no prefix sum equals z, p' already avoids all of M (since M = M' ∪ {z} and z is never hit)——验证前缀和避开 M
The general case (unsorted a) is reduced to the sorted case by composing with the sorting permutation——将一般情形归约到有序情形，验证 WLOG 的合法性
